profile.name: Tango命令代理
profile.description: 这是一个面向 Tango 控制系统的通用命令与信号代理接口，用于在实验室、光束线或自动化实验装置中连接接入 Tango 的设备，读取当前值与读回值、写入设定或命令，并接收状态更新。根据现有证据，它并不对应单一物理仪器，而是用于操作各类 Tango 受控设备的通用控制组件。
profile.description_en: This is a generic command and signal proxy interface for the Tango control system, used in laboratories, beamlines, and automated experimental setups to connect to Tango-managed devices, read current and write-back values, send setpoints or commands, and receive updates. Based on the available evidence, it does not represent a single physical instrument but a general control component for interacting with Tango-controlled equipment.
